title: Count every category
prompt: Repair `tally(items: Category[]): Record<Category, number>`. `Category` is `"fruit" | "veg" | "dairy"`. Return an object with all three keys, each set to how many times that category appears in `items`. A category that never appears has the count 0.
hints: What does the starter return for `["veg", "veg"]`?
Start with all three keys set to 0.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Starts from `{}` with `as`, so categories that never appear are missing instead of 0.
Sets each seen category to 1 instead of counting.

feedback: What does the starter return for `["veg", "veg"]`?
